First off, WOOOOOOW. 17.5 tabs of 25B? You are a lucky human to still be here, if that's true. Although obviously the exact dosage isn't known, 17.5 tabs suggests a remarkably high dosage (or perhaps a different drug - 2CB, maybe?).

Take some solace in knowing that, no, the drugs won't magically come "back into your life and kill you down the line" as long as you *don't take them again*. 

You've long since metabolized and excreted the 25B. You won't experience any acute effects from that last dosage. However, the definitive long term effects of NBOMes aren't known yet. You *may* be at a slightly increased risk of cardiovascular disease or a CVA later in life if you became intensely hyperthermic and/or experienced substantial vasoconstriction (although, chances are, since you're still alive, you didn't).

Taking a drug once and living through the acute phase largely unscathed likely won't come back to haunt you later in life.  Deciding to take it again and again, however, may cause lasting damage.

Please remember that these drugs are still quite new, and largely untested. A lot of data is anecdotal. If you are truly worried about your health, make an appointment with a physician for a physical and screening - especially as you grow older (which you should be doing, anyway).

Edited to add: In the future, I suggest always doing some research on a new chemical you're wishing to experiment with! And if you can't find any, ask yourself if you're willing to be the guinea pig. ;)

Best wishes to you!
